capabilities: , Pause on any line, Listen and read subtitles, Look up word meaning and reading, Record self reading and compare audio, Write notes on sentences
extras: Desktop only; local files are never uploaded.
problem: Learners lose valuable vocabulary and context when watching anime or dramas because they cannot pause, look up words, or review specific lines.
summary: Converts local video and subtitle files into interactive Japanese study material for vocabulary lookup, practice, and review.
